title: Adaptive Test-Time Compute Allocation with Evolving In-Context Demonstrations
authors_zh: Bowen Zuo、Dongruo Zhou、Yinglun Zhu（机构：加州大学河滨分校、印第安纳大学布卢明顿分校）
paper_type_zh: 自适应测试时计算分配与演化上下文学习研究
best_for_zh: 研究测试集级计算分配与检索条件化测试时扩展的读者。
one_line: The method reallocates later inference rounds to unresolved queries and conditions them on successful, semantically related test-time demonstrations.
该方法把后续推理轮次分配给未解决问题，并用语义相近的成功测试时示例改变其生成条件。
why: It exposes that a test-time budget changes not only how many samples are generated but also which successful generations can alter future sampling.
inclusion_reason: It jointly allocates test-time samples across unresolved inputs and changes the conditional generation distribution through evolving demonstrations.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Uniform best-of-N sampling repeats the same generation process for every test question, even after some questions have already produced a correct answer. Adaptive elimination saves samples by stopping solved questions, but the unresolved questions are still sampled from their original conditional distribution. When the correct solution is unlikely under that distribution, repeatedly spending more budget can yield near-duplicate failures rather than a new route to success.

This paper asks how a test-time allocation policy can decide both where computation should go and how later computation should change generation. Its setting is a collection of test questions evaluated together: early samples resolve easy questions and become a pool of candidate demonstrations, while later samples are reserved for unresolved questions and conditioned on semantically related successful examples from that evolving pool.

统一的最佳候选采样会为每个测试问题重复同一种生成过程，即使其中一些问题已经产生正确答案。自适应淘汰虽然能通过停止已解决问题来节约样本，但未解决问题仍从原始条件分布中采样。当正确解在该分布下概率很低时，继续投入更多预算往往只会得到相近的失败回答，而不是通向成功的新路径。

本文研究测试时分配策略如何同时决定计算投向哪里，以及后续计算如何改变生成。它的设置是一组共同评测的测试问题：早期样本解决简单题并成为候选示例池，后续样本则保留给未解决问题，并以池中语义相关的成功示例作为条件。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The method couples adaptive allocation with self-adaptive in-context learning. A warm-up stage gives every question a small fixed number of zero-shot generations. A verifier marks questions solved when any response passes, removes them from the active set, and places their successful question-response pairs into a growing demonstration pool. This first stage therefore serves as both inexpensive difficulty estimation and evidence collection.

In later rounds, computation is spent only on the active set. For each unresolved query, the method retrieves up to three semantically closest questions and their successful responses, inserts them as in-context demonstrations, and samples from the resulting conditional distribution. The pool changes as more questions are solved, so a fixed base model obtains a test-time distribution shift without fine-tuning or a separate learned allocation model.

该方法把自适应分配与自适应上下文学习结合起来。预热阶段为每个问题提供少量固定的零样本生成。验证器在任一回答通过时标记问题已解决，将其从活跃集合移除，并把成功的问题—回答对放入不断增长的示例池。因此，第一阶段同时承担低成本难度估计和证据收集。

在后续轮次中，计算只花在活跃集合上。对于每个未解决查询，方法检索最多三个语义最相近的问题及其成功回答，将它们插入上下文示例，并从得到的条件分布采样。随着更多问题被解决，示例池持续变化，因此固定基础模型无需微调或独立学习的分配模型，也能获得测试时分布迁移。

title: Method
方法
html:
The algorithm initializes an answer pool and active set for all test queries. During the one-round warm-up, it generates K responses per query using a zero-shot chain-of-thought prompt. Ground-truth correctness is the main reward oracle and a question is removed when any response is correct. The method embeds all questions, fixes a semantic neighborhood for each query, and records successful responses as the evolving test-time demonstration set.

During adaptive rounds, each active query receives an in-context prompt composed of the most recent successful responses from its top-P neighbors; the paper uses four total rounds and P equals three by default. It evaluates MATH-500, LiveCodeBench, MinervaMath, GPQA-Diamond, and a 400-question hard Reasoning Gym set using Gemini-2.5-flash-lite with and without thinking, GPT-4.1 Mini, and GPT-5 Nano. Comparisons include uniform best-of-N, adaptive elimination with a fixed generation distribution, and random rather than similarity-selected demonstrations; coverage and output-token curves are reported over four runs.

算法为所有测试查询初始化回答池和活跃集合。在单轮预热中，它使用零样本思维链提示为每个查询生成 K 个回答。主要奖励预言机是真实标签正确性；任一回答正确时，问题就会被移除。方法嵌入所有问题，为每个查询固定语义邻域，并把成功回答记录为不断演化的测试时示例集合。

在自适应轮次中，每个活跃查询都会得到由其前 P 个邻居最近成功回答组成的上下文提示；论文默认总轮数为四，P 等于三。它使用启用和未启用思考的 Gemini-2.5-flash-lite、GPT-4.1 Mini 与 GPT-5 Nano，在 MATH-500、LiveCodeBench、MinervaMath、GPQA-Diamond 和 400 题的困难 Reasoning Gym 集上评测。比较对象包括统一最佳候选、生成分布固定的自适应淘汰，以及随机而非语义选择的示例；覆盖率和输出 token 曲线均在四次运行中报告。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper’s main evidence is a set of coverage-versus-output-token curves across five benchmarks and four API model configurations. On MATH-500, the similarity-conditioned adaptive version is above uniform sampling, elimination, and its own random-demonstration variant over the shown token ranges for Gemini with and without thinking, GPT-4.1 Mini, and GPT-5 Nano. The same qualitative ordering is reported on LiveCodeBench, MinervaMath, GPQA-Diamond, and the hard Reasoning Gym evaluation, with GPT-5 Nano on Reasoning Gym noted as an exception where prompt conditioning is less sensitive.

The ablations isolate the proposed distribution change. Neighbor prompting exceeds the fixed prompt on MATH-500, while random demonstrations are less stable and can underperform on reasoning-intensive benchmarks. The paper also substitutes temperature scheduling for evolving demonstrations, evaluates a self-consistency version that stops at 75% consensus, and tests reward-model and 5%-noisy-reward variants. These checks support the narrower claim that structured, similarity-based conditioning improves allocation efficiency beyond merely eliminating solved questions.

论文的主要证据是一组跨五个基准和四种 API 模型配置的覆盖率—输出 token 曲线。在 MATH-500 上，基于相似度条件化的自适应版本在展示的 token 范围内高于统一采样、淘汰策略和自身的随机示例变体，涉及启用与未启用思考的 Gemini、GPT-4.1 Mini 和 GPT-5 Nano。LiveCodeBench、MinervaMath、GPQA-Diamond 与困难 Reasoning Gym 上也报告了同样的定性排序；但论文指出 GPT-5 Nano 在 Reasoning Gym 上是例外，因为它对提示条件化不那么敏感。

消融实验隔离了所提出的分布变化。邻居提示在 MATH-500 上超过固定提示，而随机示例更不稳定，且在推理密集基准上可能表现更差。论文还用温度调度替代演化示例，评估在 75% 共识时停止的自一致性版本，并测试奖励模型和 5% 噪声奖励变体。这些检查支持较窄的结论：结构化、基于相似度的条件化能在只淘汰已解决问题之外进一步提高分配效率。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Prior allocation methods primarily decide how many independent samples a question receives while leaving its sampling distribution unchanged. This paper changes the reusable inference record: a verified response to one test question becomes a retrieved demonstration that changes the conditional distribution of later, related questions. Allocation, verification, retrieval, and prompting are therefore joined in one round-based loop rather than evaluated as separate modules.

The novelty is not in a new verifier or a new language model. It is the transductive, test-set-level use of solved responses as an evolving control surface for additional inference. Before reuse, inspect whether examples from one evaluation item may legitimately condition another, whether the verifier makes false-positive demonstrations enter the pool, how prompts affect input-token cost, and whether the benchmark protocol allows test-set adaptation. Those checks are especially important because the main procedure uses ground-truth correctness during evaluation.

已有分配方法主要决定一个问题获得多少独立样本，同时保持其采样分布不变。本文改变了可复用的推理记录：某个测试问题经验证的回答会成为检索到的示例，改变后续相关问题的条件分布。因此，分配、验证、检索和提示被连接在一个按轮运行的循环中，而不是被当作彼此独立的模块评估。

新意不在新的验证器或新的语言模型，而在于把已解决回答作为不断演化的控制表面，以测试集级、跨问题的方式为额外推理服务。复用前应检查一个评测项目的示例是否可以合法地作为另一个项目的条件、验证器误报是否会把错误示例放入池中、提示如何影响输入 token 成本，以及基准协议是否允许测试集适应。这些检查尤为重要，因为主要过程在评测期间使用真实标签正确性。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The central procedure is transductive: it uses test questions and their verifier outcomes to construct demonstrations for other test questions. That can be appropriate for a batched deployment workload, but it can invalidate a conventional independent-example benchmark interpretation and makes ordering, grouping, and verifier access part of the result. Incorrectly verified answers may contaminate later prompts, retrieval can select superficially similar but misleading examples, and added demonstrations consume input context that the reported output-token accounting does not fully expose. The method also depends on API-model reproducibility and has no official implementation release to audit its exact prompts, embeddings, and response-processing details.

核心过程具有传导性：它使用测试问题及其验证结果为其他测试问题构造示例。这可以适用于批量部署工作负载，却可能破坏传统的独立样本基准解释，并使顺序、分组和验证器访问成为结果的一部分。被错误验证的答案可能污染后续提示，检索也可能选到表面相似却误导性的示例；新增示例还会消耗输入上下文，而报告的输出 token 统计并未充分暴露这一成本。方法还依赖 API 模型的可复现性，且没有官方实现可供审计其精确提示、嵌入和回答处理细节。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this paper to design a batched inference service in which successfully verified requests can help related unresolved requests during the same run. The reusable recipe is to define a verifier contract, run a low-cost warm-up, exclude solved items, retrieve only semantically close and verified demonstrations, and plot both quality and total input-plus-output cost against a no-sharing baseline. It is not a drop-in evaluation protocol for benchmarks requiring item independence. Any adoption should freeze the allowed information flow, log demonstration provenance per answer, test false-positive propagation, and report how results change when test-set reuse is disabled.
当一个批量推理服务允许已验证成功的请求在同一次运行中帮助相关的未解决请求时，可以使用这篇论文。可复用配方是定义验证契约、运行低成本预热、排除已解决项目、只检索语义接近且已验证的示例，并相对无共享基线绘制质量与总输入加输出成本。它并不是要求项目独立的基准的即插即用评测协议。任何采用都应冻结允许的信息流、为每个答案记录示例来源、测试误报传播，并报告关闭测试集复用后结果如何变化。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Remember that this is not only an early-exit method. It redistributes sampling from solved to unresolved questions and simultaneously changes the unresolved questions’ prompts with retrieved successes. Its main metric is coverage, which is easier to optimize with a correctness oracle than final-answer accuracy in open tasks. The appealing efficiency result should be read alongside the transductive protocol: the method’s strongest resource is information created from the test workload itself. The paper is most useful as a design pattern for controlled online batches, and least transferable to isolated, hidden-label, or contamination-sensitive evaluation settings.
要记住，这不只是一个早停方法。它把采样从已解决问题重新分配给未解决问题，同时用检索到的成功回答改变未解决问题的提示。其主要指标是覆盖率，在存在正确性预言机时比开放任务的最终答案准确率更容易优化。吸引人的效率结果应与传导性协议一起理解：该方法最强的资源来自测试工作负载自身产生的信息。论文最适合作为受控在线批处理的设计模式，最难迁移到孤立、标签隐藏或对污染敏感的评测环境。
